findings.issue: Theme system has no SSR-safe hydration — theme class is set client-side after hydration, causing flash-of-unstyled-theme (FOUT)
findings.impact: Users see light theme briefly before dark theme applies on page load; poor perceived performance
findings.fix: Implement SSR-safe theme hydration: read theme preference from cookie on server, inject theme class into <html> before React hydration, suppress hydration warning

findings.issue: Only 2 themes (light/dark) defined via CSS class — no slate dark, OLED high-contrast, or multi-theme token system
findings.impact: Cannot support 4+ named themes without expanding token system to multi-variable per theme pattern
findings.fix: Redesign CSS variable system: define all color tokens per theme (--color-bg-primary, --color-text-primary, etc.), create theme classes (.theme-light, .theme-slate-dark, .theme-oled-black), migrate existing light/dark tokens

findings.issue: Theme toggle only supports system/light/dark — no named theme selection UI
findings.impact: Users cannot choose Slate Dark or OLED High-Contrast themes from preferences
findings.fix: Update theme preferences: add theme selection UI in settings (Light, Slate Dark, OLED Black, System), persist as theme_name in user_preferences table

findings.issue: No automated contrast validation for theme tokens — dark mode and OLED mode contrast not verified
findings.impact: New themes may fail WCAG AA contrast requirements; accessibility regressions
findings.fix: Add automated contrast check in CI: compare all theme token combinations against WCAG AA ratios; fail build on contrast violations
